# TechCoder

> TechCoder is an independent technology publication with practical programming guides, AI coverage, technology explainers, and product reviews for curious readers and developers.

Use published article dates and update dates as context. Treat TechCoder articles as editorial coverage, not as official vendor documentation; follow cited primary sources when exact product behavior or current technical details matter. Draft posts and private CMS/API routes are not public resources.

Article pages are served as regular HTML; separate Markdown versions are not currently published. Start from the blog or a topic page, then fetch relevant article pages as needed.

## Start here

- [Home](https://techcoder.tech/): Overview of TechCoder and links to current coverage.
- [Articles](https://techcoder.tech/blog): Published article index.
- [About TechCoder](https://techcoder.tech/about): Publication and editorial information.

## Topics

- [Programming](https://techcoder.tech/topics/programming): Programming languages, frameworks, developer tools, and software engineering.
- [AI](https://techcoder.tech/topics/ai): AI models, tools, and developer workflows.
- [Technology](https://techcoder.tech/topics/technology): Technology trends, products, and explainers.
